name: When is the best time to install door stops, such as during a renovation or as a standalone project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install door stops, such as during a renovation or as a standalone project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing door stops is beneficial at any time, but integrating it into a renovation project, such as a kitchen or bathroom remodel, can be highly efficient. During a renovation, walls are often exposed or receiving new finishes, making it ideal for precise placement and ensuring aesthetic continuity. However, door stop installation can also be a quick and effective standalone project to prevent immediate damage to walls or furniture. If you're undertaking a larger project with us in Meridian or Star, we can easily incorporate this service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door stops can be installed anytime, but integrating them into a renovation project can be more efficient, especially when walls are exposed.
